description: This file defines the AttributeCriteria class, which models criteria for product attributes including attribute code and value.

classes.name: AttributeCriteria
classes.description: A Java class implementing Serializable that encapsulates product attribute criteria with getters and setters for attribute code and value.

methods.name: setAttributeCode
methods.description: Sets the attribute code for this criteria.

methods.name: getAttributeCode
methods.description: Returns the attribute code for this criteria.

methods.name: setAttributeValue
methods.description: Sets the attribute value for this criteria.

methods.name: getAttributeValue
methods.description: Returns the attribute value for this criteria.
